verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents provisioning Team Computers and assigning them in advance to a team member or group. That is the product's own pre-configured access mechanism, but the evidence never says connections then proceed without someone at the host accepting them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of unattended or no-accept connections, details of how credentials or permissions are configured ahead of time, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: Once a Team Computer is provisioned, it can be assigned to either a single team member or a group.
Parsec for Teams seamlessly connects teams to their hardware so they can maintain workflows and make amazing things, all while working from anywhere.
